sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठम् अरुदम् भृश दुःखितः ।अथ ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तम् तु भगवान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-६२-१॥
transliteration: evam uktvā muniśreṣṭham arudam bhṛśa duḥkhitaḥ ।atha dhyātvā muhūrtam tu bhagavān idam abravīt ॥4-62-1॥

translations.english: 'When thus I spoke to the venerable sage in that manner roaring very painfully the divine sage replied after reflecting silently for a moment:
